title: Fix missing students across classes (ID collisions + persistence across upgrades)

requirements.text: Prevent students from disappearing when users add students in multiple classes/sections by eliminating ID collisions in the backend storage keying strategy.

quotes:
Student sabhi gayab ho gaye hai
Maine 9,8,7 class main student add kiya the vo sab gayab ho gaye hai

acceptanceCriteria: Adding students to Class 7, Class 8, and Class 9 does not overwrite previously added students in other classes/sections.
After adding students to multiple classes/sections, each class/section’s Student List shows the correct students when navigating between classes.
Backend rejects or safely handles any attempt to add/update a student record that would overwrite an unrelated existing student due to non-unique IDs.

requirements.text: Update the add-student flow so that student IDs are generated in a globally unique way (not based on the count within the currently selected class/section).
acceptanceCriteria: Creating a student in an empty class/section after adding students elsewhere still produces a unique ID that does not conflict with existing students.
No class/section uses duplicated IDs that cause another class/section’s student to disappear.
User-facing behavior remains the same: user enters Student Name, Roll Number, and Parent Mobile Number and the student appears in the current class/section list.

requirements.text: Persist student records (and any required ID counters/indexes) across canister upgrades so previously added students do not disappear after a redeploy/upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: After an upgrade, previously added students are still returned by the backend APIs and appear in the UI.
The backend’s ID generation continues correctly after an upgrade (no reset that could reintroduce ID collisions).

requirements.text: Add a safe recovery/diagnostic path in the UI for when the current class/section shows no students, helping confirm whether data exists in the backend (e.g., by optionally loading a count of all students) and showing a clear English error/state message when unauthorized or when data is genuinely empty.

quotes: Ismein vah student nahin dikh raha hai jo maine different classes mein add kiye the
Student sabhi gayab ho gaye hai

acceptanceCriteria: When the Student List is empty, the UI distinguishes (in English) between: not logged in/not authorized, loading error, and genuinely no students.
There is a way to confirm whether any students exist in the backend even if the selected class/section list is empty (without exposing private data to unauthorized users).

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not modify frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts/.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (compose instead).
nonGoals: Do not implement the monthly attendance download/export feature in this build (PDF/Excel/CSV).
Do not add third-party authentication providers; Internet Identity only.
